regimeSub: Markets frozen pre-Wednesday CPI as July -23K NFP shock collides with sticky 3.5% inflation, Warsh boxed in.

headline: Markets frozen ahead of Wednesday CPI as July's -23K jobs shock leaves Fed Chair Warsh paralyzed between 3.5% inflation and growth cracking to 1.5%, with BOK and BOJ both signaling hikes despite currency stress.
